title: Кино Нагиева и новая квартира  (Nagiyev's Movie and the New Apartment)

scenes.title: Съёмки в отеле  (Filming in the Hotel)
scenes.summary: Barinov ruins a take of Nagiyev's action movie by walking into the frame and arguing with the crew over the fake blood on the floor.

scenes.title: Спор о высоком искусстве  (An Argument About High Art)
scenes.summary: Barinov worries a Michelin critic might arrive during the chaotic film shoot, while Nagiyev brags that Eleonora authorized the filming.

scenes.title: Подарок от отца Насти  (A Gift from Nastya's Father)
scenes.summary: Nastya's father pretends the new apartment is a cheap rental from a friend in Bali, then secretly reveals to Kostya that he bought it for them.

scenes.title: Вызов на футбольный матч  (Challenge to a Football Match)
scenes.summary: With no guests in the restaurant during the movie shoot, Senya, Denis, and Nikita organize a football match in the courtyard in front of Katya.

scenes.title: Травма актёра и поиск замены  (The Actor's Injury and Finding a Replacement)
scenes.summary: When Nagiyev's co-star injures his ankle, the director proposes casting Chef Barinov for the role because of the natural tension between him and Nagiyev.

scenes.title: Кошмар Кости и проблема Шефа  (Kostya's Nightmare and Chef's Problem)
scenes.summary: Kostya dreams that Nastya's father owns their whole life, while at the hotel Barinov worries about showing zero profit on his new menu just as Nagiyev walks in.

scenes.title: Сделка на сто тысяч  (A Hundred-Thousand-Ruble Deal)
scenes.summary: Nagiyev convinces Barinov to act in his movie for 100,000 rubles plus a full crew lunch order from Barinov's auteur menu.

scenes.title: Признание Кости  (Kostya's Confession)
scenes.summary: Unable to relax in a home bought by his father-in-law, Kostya confesses to Nastya that her father gifted them the apartment and suggests turning it down.

scenes.title: Принципы ради сына и начало матча  (Principles for Their Son and Kickoff)
scenes.summary: Nastya convinces Kostya to keep the apartment for their son's sake and sends him to buy groceries for a housewarming, while the courtyard football match kicks off.

scenes.title: Камера, мотор, дубль один!  (Camera, Rolling, Take One!)
scenes.summary: The chefs pause their football game at 5–3 to cook lunch for the crew, and Barinov collects his 100,000-ruble fee in cash from Nagiyev before Take 1.

scenes.title: Муки актёрского мастерства  (The Agony of Acting)
scenes.summary: Barinov alternates between wooden delivery and theatrical overacting in Takes 1 and 2, testing Nagiyev's patience on set.

scenes.title: Обед для группы и ставка на Катю  (Lunch for the Crew and a Bet Over Katya)
scenes.summary: The film crew breaks for Barinov's lunch, and in the courtyard Nikita and Denis agree that whoever loses the football game must step aside and leave Katya alone.

scenes.title: Новоселье с родителями Насти  (Housewarming with Nastya's Parents)
scenes.summary: Nastya's parents arrive for the housewarming, and Kostya grows defensive when his father-in-law offers to buy them a plasma TV and mocks Kostya's inexpensive cognac.

scenes.title: Спор о сценарии и пенальти  (Script Argument and Penalty Kick)
scenes.summary: Barinov criticizes the logic of Nagiyev's movie title, while in the courtyard football game Nikita trips Denis, leading to a high-stakes penalty shot.

scenes.title: Новая идея для трюка  (A New Idea for a Stunt)
scenes.summary: Dissatisfied with the script's cliché flask-stopping-a-bullet scene, Nagiyev decides his hero will catch Barinov's bullet in his teeth.

scenes.title: Пуля для Нагиева  (A Bullet for Nagiyev)
scenes.summary: Nagiyev orders the prop master to fashion a prop bullet for his mouth stunt, while at the apartment Kostya slices sausage for Nastya's parents.

scenes.title: Спор о колбасе и квартире  (Arguing Over Sausage and the Apartment)
scenes.summary: Nastya's father and Kostya argue heatedly over cheap versus premium sausage as a veiled argument about accepting the gifted apartment.

scenes.title: Удар мячом и найденная пуля  (Hit by the Ball and the Found Bullet)
scenes.summary: Denis and Nikita accidentally hit Katya in the face with the football during the penalty kick, while the prop master hands Nagiyev a sanitized bullet.

scenes.title: Проглоченная пуля и гнев Кати  (The Swallowed Bullet and Katya's Anger)
scenes.summary: Eleonora interrupts the explosive shootout scene and startles Nagiyev into swallowing the bullet, while Katya tells Denis and Nikita to stay away from her forever.

scenes.title: Одна семья и бутафорские деньги  (One Family and Prop Money)
scenes.summary: Kostya reconciles with Nastya's father as one family, and Barinov discovers that the 100,000 rubles Nagiyev paid him are worthless prop banknotes.
